pitches.text: The trailing 30 days is the window you screen on, so everything here is from that window. Over it the wallet closed more than five thousand trades and won the clear majority of them. A win rate that holds across a sample that size is a process, not luck. Size the position to the quality of that evidence rather than treating it as no evidence.

pitches.text: The edge shows up across the book rather than in one lucky name. Several unrelated instruments finished the 30 days in profit: a memecoin, a major and an L1 all contributing, with PONS the largest single contributor. Breadth like that across markets that do not move together is the signature of a real process, and the fees against those gains are almost nothing.
